profile.a: Finite exact value represented as numerator a over shared positive denominator d.
profile.b: Exact absolute finite nonzero step represented as positive numerator b over d.
profile.r: Supplied exact truncating remainder numerator; not SMT-LIB fp.rem.
profile.q: Unbounded mathematical integer witnessing a=q*b+r, not a native computed quotient.

contracts: Positive step; remainder magnitude strictly less than step; remainder sign agrees with input unless zero; exact decomposition.
Nonzero remainder for directed adjacent-bounds results; exact-zero branch returns input and its mathematical multiple identity is checked separately.
Rust f32 remainder correctness relative to this contract is external.
Actual f64 reconstruction/distances and final f32 projection need their own IEEE refinement; arbitrary exponent-gap addition exactness is not assumed.
Rat identifies positive and negative zero; native copysign/signed-zero, NaN/infinity and CSS provider/type/lifetime contracts are external.

candidate_mapping.remainder_bounds: value-remainder with sign-directed neighboring step reconstructs consecutive multiples strictly bracketing value.
candidate_mapping.adjacent_directed: No other integer multiple between the selected lower/upper bound and value.
candidate_mapping.nearest_minimal_upper_tie: The chosen adjacent multiple is globally distance-minimal among all multiples; equal-distance ties cannot lie above the chosen result.
candidate_mapping.remainder_toward_zero: Smaller-magnitude-bound selection equals value-remainder under the supplied contract.
candidate_mapping.common_denominator_order: Positive rational scaling preserves the integer comparison.
candidate_mapping.rational_nearest_refinement: Comparing exact rational distances chooses precisely the projected integer-scale nearest result.
